{{Quote|It was I who grew the Leviathans, who splintered the Jedi barricades at Balmorra.|Sorzus Syn|<ref name="BoS" />}}
A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] during the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. The [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathans]] who were bred by the ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] splintered the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] barricades on the planet.<ref name="BoS" />
